description: Finding 9, as Zig does it: streaming a short value needs the slot's position, which a sorted key reached by sorted_map_get with key doesn't have, so a two-byte key raises ExpectedSlotPosition while a long one works. Since 71ee0cf a key-only entry's key from read_key_value_pair has the entry's position, so that one streams in both (stream-short-set-key).
